answer: Picture a violet beacon on a mesa, visible to every trader: a new identity earns full rights only after its ledger shows 50 genuine trades with 20 distinct counterparties over 90 days, each paying a $0.50 fee. One fake costs $25 plus 90 days, and fakes may not share counterparties, so the hundredth fake needs 2,000 distinct counterparties and bulk forgery collapses.
